author: Totally Not Mark
description:
It’s 2015 again. Dragon Ball Super is back, and there’s more going on than you might think. We break down the Beerus remaster, compare what’s changed, cover the Moro announcement, AND reveal some exclusive new details along the way.

Special thanks to Anime Ajay for supplying the info for this video. 

Ajay's twitter: https://x.com/AnimeAjay
title: Everything You Need to Know about Dragon Ball Super's RETURN!
